json.subject: A question about your north-side roofing work
json.body:
Hello,

I came across Acme Roofing while looking for family-run contractors that keep their own vans and crews rather than subcontracting the work out. That is the part I wanted to ask about.

We are putting together a short list of contractors in the area and would like to include you. If that is of interest, reply to this message and I will send the details.

Thanks for your time.

json.subject: A question about your work
json.body:
Hello,

No fixture entry matched this business, so this is the default draft. It is deliberately plain: no link, no number, nothing for a reader to follow anywhere.

If a first email is welcome, reply to this message and I will send the details.

Thanks for your time.
